name: Livnat et al. algorithm for unstructured tetrahedral grids
definition: An algorithm for extracting isosurfaces from unstructured grids of tetrahedral cells, leveraging the property that if an isosurface intersects a cell, the vertex with the maximum value is above the isosurface and the vertex with the minimum value is below it.
summary: Livnat's algorithm extracts isosurfaces from unstructured tetrahedral grids by streaming cells to GPU vertex shaders, using hybrid CPU/GPU interval trees for up to 7x speedup over brute-force methods.
